data.content_ref: inline:The 'fragmentation firewall' in SRC_004 is compatible with the 'stochastic filter' in SRC_002, as both describe the mechanism by which divergence in implementation prevents the propagation of single-point-of-failure triggers; this relation is refuted if operational heterogeneity (recovery procedures) does not provide the same protection as software stack heterogeneity (kernels/libraries).
